                            2025 CAPITAL OUTLAY REAUTHORIZATIONS
       Senate Finance Committee Substitute for Senate Bill 425 (Laws 2025, Chapter 158, p.v.)
VETO=governor vetoed entire reauthorization
LV=governor vetoed language within reauthorization

          The legislature may reauthorize funds that have been appropriated for capital outlay projects in previous
years to change, expand or clarify the project purpose; to extend the time of expenditure or the certification period
for the project; or to change the administering agency. Descriptions of the projects that were reauthorized in 2025
are presented here in the numerical order in which they appear in the bill. Projects are presented in the bill in
alphabetical order by the county in which they have most recently been authorized. Original citations for the
reauthorized projects appear in italics following the text of each project listing. The governor vetoed 97 projects in
their entirety and vetoed language in 14 projects as indicated in the listings below.
